row.evidence: Doodle's pricing page lists SSO (SAML/OIDC) only on Enterprise (starts at USD 15k), its help centre covers members only through invites, CSV import and manual removal, and says Doodle no longer supports new API; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: No SCIM found by absence: searched the pricing page, the doodle.com sitemap, the full help-centre sitemap (Team Plan Admins and Security collections) and Okta's catalogue. SSO (SAML/OIDC) is Enterprise only (Custom pricing, starts at USD 15k billed annually) and is enabled through a form handled by Doodle's security team. Team is $16/seat/mo billed annually for 2-5 seats (lower per-seat tiers at 6-20 and 21+). Doodle's API is deprecated for new customers. Removing a member only removes subscription access, the Doodle account remains. The Okta OIN app is SWA only.

user_api.notes: Doodle no longer supports new API; existing Enterprise API setups are told to contact support.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Aug. 30 2018) has only SWA checked in the page markup despite the generic 'supports Single Sign-On' line.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (doodle-tutorial returns 404).

fallbacks.notes: Doodle recommends Google/Microsoft social login so that de-provisioning the corporate email cuts access; not SCIM.
